name: Oficina Mecânica · Negócio
description: Indicadores de negócio da operação da oficina, derivados dos custom events emitidos pelos eventos de domínio da aplicação (seção 7 dos Contratos). Substitua 0 em accountIds pelo ID da sua conta New Relic e ajuste env nas cláusulas WHERE.

pages.name: Visão geral
pages.description: Volume, funil e valor das Ordens de Serviço.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'OS abertas' FROM ServiceOrderCreated WHERE env = 'prod' SINCE today COMPARE WITH 1 day ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Entregues' FROM ServiceOrderStatusChanged WHERE env = 'prod' AND toStatus = 'DELIVERED' SINCE today COMPARE WITH 1 day ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE toStatus = 'REJECTED') AS 'Recusa %' FROM ServiceOrderStatusChanged WHERE env = 'prod' AND toStatus IN ('EXECUTING', 'REJECTED') SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT uniqueCount(customerId) AS 'Clientes' FROM ServiceOrderCreated WHERE env = 'prod' SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Volume diário de Ordens de Serviço

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'OS abertas' FROM ServiceOrderCreated WHERE env = 'prod' SINCE 30 days ago TIMESERIES 1 day
SELECT count(*) AS 'Abertas' FROM ServiceOrderCreated WHERE env = 'prod' SINCE 30 days ago TIMESERIES 1 day
SELECT count(*) AS 'Entregues' FROM ServiceOrderStatusChanged WHERE env = 'prod' AND toStatus = 'DELIVERED' SINCE 30 days ago TIMESERIES 1 day

widgets.title: Funil de status — transições nos últimos 30 dias

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT funnel(orderId, WHERE toStatus = 'DIAGNOSIS' AS 'Diagnóstico', WHERE toStatus = 'AWAITING_APPROVAL' AS 'Aguardando aprovação', WHERE toStatus = 'EXECUTING' AS 'Em execução', WHERE toStatus = 'FINISHED' AS 'Finalizada', WHERE toStatus = 'DELIVERED' AS 'Entregue') FROM ServiceOrderStatusChanged WHERE env = 'prod' SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Distribuição das transições por status de destino

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM ServiceOrderStatusChanged WHERE env = 'prod' FACET toStatus SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Tempo médio de permanência em cada status (horas)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(durationSeconds) / 3600 AS 'Horas no status anterior' FROM ServiceOrderStatusChanged WHERE env = 'prod' AND fromStatus IS NOT NULL FACET fromStatus SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Tempo médio por status ao longo do tempo (horas)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(durationSeconds) / 3600 FROM ServiceOrderStatusChanged WHERE env = 'prod' AND fromStatus IS NOT NULL FACET fromStatus SINCE 30 days ago TIMESERIES 1 day

widgets.title: Lead time total — abertura até entrega (horas)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(durationSeconds) / 3600 / uniqueCount(orderId) AS 'Lead time médio (h)' FROM ServiceOrderStatusChanged WHERE env = 'prod' AND fromStatus IS NOT NULL SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT average(totalAmount) AS 'Ticket médio' FROM ServiceOrderStatusChanged WHERE env = 'prod' AND toStatus = 'FINISHED' SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Ticket médio e faturamento por dia (R$)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(totalAmount) AS 'Ticket médio', sum(totalAmount) AS 'Faturamento' FROM ServiceOrderStatusChanged WHERE env = 'prod' AND toStatus = 'FINISHED' SINCE 30 days ago TIMESERIES 1 day
SELECT timestamp, orderId, customerId, vehicleId, correlationId FROM ServiceOrderCreated WHERE env = 'prod' SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 100
